summary: Preserve paced per-item profile-count enrichment for list-quality scoring and opt-in segment listings.
reason: Klaviyo's list and segment collection endpoints reject profile_count as a sparse field, while their per-item additional-field variants are limited to a 1/s burst and 15/m steady rate; collection-only scoring silently produced all-zero list sizes and segment listings had no safe count helper.
validated_outcome: a production account live checks returned populated per-item segment counts with paced requests and list-quality-score no longer returned an all-zero size column.
